commentary.text: 90+12' The match has just finished.
90+12' Everton work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+12' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Everton will take a corner kick.
90+10' Everton have been awarded a corner kick.

90+10' Tyrique George (Everton) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Antonin Kinsky has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Everton.
90+7' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Antonin Kinsky (Tottenham).

90+7' That was close! Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
90+4' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' The substitution is prepared. Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Destiny Udogie.
89' James Tarkowski (Everton) sees a yellow card from Michael Oliver after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
88' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner.
87' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) is given a yellow card.

67' The ball is out of play. Everton win a corner kick.
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 19:5.

63' Tyrique George (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Everton have a corner.
62' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harrison Armstrong (Everton) replacing Jake O'Brien.
62' Substitution. Merlin Rohl walks off the pitch and Tyrique George (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
56' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Thierno Barry (Everton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Tottenham earn a free kick.
51' Poor challenge! Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is penalised for tripping and Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Everton have a free kick.
50' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will take the corner.
49' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

48' Djed Spence (Tottenham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Jordan Pickford pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
47' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' The whistle blows and Michael Oliver starts the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+2' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
43' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
43' The referee awards a corner and Mathys Tel (Tottenham) goes over to take it.

42' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
41' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Merlin Rohl (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.
40' What a great touch by Mathys Tel (Tottenham) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
39' Richarlison (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle. Everton have been awarded a free kick.
35' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) will take a corner kick.
35' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Tottenham are going to take it.
33' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
32' Djed Spence (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Free kick. Everton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
31' James Tarkowski (Everton) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Tottenham in a dangerous position.
30' 66:34 – the ratio of ball possession.
26' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Everton.
24' A cooling break is underway.
23' Djed Spence (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but Jordan Pickford punches the ball away.
20' Merlin Rohl (Everton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Tottenham are awarded the free kick.
19' Merlin Rohl (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Tottenham are awarded a free kick.
18' Good defending. Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) tries to find Mathys Tel inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
16' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Djed Spence (Tottenham). Everton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
16' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

14' Unbelievable miss! Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
13' The game is interrupted. Jake O'Brien (Everton) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
10' Kevin Danso (Tottenham) blows a big chance from close range. His effort flies high and wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
10' Corner kick. Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Djed Spence (Tottenham). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.

9' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.

7' Conor Gallagher (Tottenham) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
4' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
4' The free kick is delivered by Pedro Porro (Tottenham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham get a free kick.
2' An attempted cross from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is cleared.
1' There's an opportunity for Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

1' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman makes the right call and Everton will have a corner.
